name: create-skill
description: Create, update, or audit agent skills and SKILL.md files. Use when the user wants to make a new /command or /skill, improve skill frontmatter or trigger pickup, benchmark whether a skill gets selected, formalize a repeating workflow into reusable agent automation, prune token bloat, or validate an existing skill. Produces skill definitions, not implementation plans.
